paths.name: Multivariate QM
paths.cost: Larger calibration samples; tens of times more compute
paths.effect: Open question - depends on the joint structure of the reference
paths.summary: Correct the joint distribution across pixels and time lags, not each margin alone. Not bound by the rank-preservation argument, but the recoverable joint structure is limited by a 0.5 deg, 172-station reference.

paths.name: Sub-daily disaggregation
paths.summary: Redistribute the corrected daily total across the day via cloud-tracking on 10-minute Himawari-9 imagery. Keeps the daily distribution and adds a within-day timing signal on top.

paths.name: Stochastic disaggregation
paths.cost: Ensemble verification stack on the downstream side
paths.effect: Reframes timing as uncertainty rather than removing it
paths.summary: Sample an ensemble of plausible daily timings consistent with the corrected distribution. Scoring shifts to CRPS and rank histograms. Best for users who are already ensemble-aware.

paths.name: Local-day re-aggregation
paths.cost: Re-run the pipeline on a re-aggregated archive (modest, archive-intensive)
paths.effect: Targets the UTC-vs-local-day artefact; most actionable for UTC+7 to UTC+9
paths.summary: Re-aggregate native half-hourly IMERG to a 24-hour window ending 07:00 local before correcting. Removes the calendar mismatch with no methodology change; expected lift r 0.34 to 0.57. The path the reproducible pipeline most directly enables.
